name: Vector Belt
briefing: Every column of the Crew Log is a vector, and every vector has a type. Names are text, mission hours are numbers, and sex, nationality and military status are categories. Get the types right and the log starts to make sense.

log.title: Entry 2: Forty nations
log.text: Decoded by type: 564 astronauts under 40 different nationality entries. Twenty-seven of those entries belong to just one person.
